2-HOUR DELAYED START — Lincoln College Prep

Supervisors will send any change by 7:00 AM. Please confirm receipt.

EARLY DISMISSAL — Lincoln College Prep

School opens on time on {day} and dismisses at 11:30 AM ahead of heavy snow. Lunch is served at 10:45 AM. After-school activities are cancelled. Staff are released at 12:15 PM once buses have cleared. Essential staff follow the essential-staff addendum.

Please confirm receipt.

REMOTE LEARNING (AMI DAY) — Lincoln College Prep

The building is closed to students on {day} because of dangerous wind chills. Teachers work from home and post AMI assignments by 8:30 AM. Hold office hours online from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Essential staff report at their normal time and follow the essential-staff addendum.

Please confirm receipt.

closure.staff:
SCHOOL CLOSED — Lincoln College Prep

School is closed on {day} because of heavy snow and hazardous roads. Do not report to the building. All activities and athletics are cancelled. Essential staff will be contacted by voice call and should follow the essential-staff addendum.

The next update will be sent by 4:00 PM. Please confirm receipt.
